title: screen operation
description: A vibrating screen on the case's size grid. The unit's `model` word selects how the partition is obtained: karra (King 2001 section 4.2.1-4.2.2, eqs. 4.30-4.48: the cloth, the inclination and the loading give the cut size; no fitted parameter) or declared (the case's partition curve and bypass). Outputs (oversize undersize). One solid population; no work, no heat.

aperture.title: Aperture h
aperture.description: karra: the cloth opening (must lie inside the size grid). declared: optional, checked against the grid.

inclination.title: Deck inclination theta (karra)
inclination.description: Write it with its unit, e.g. `20 deg`; in [0, 90) degrees.

deck.title: Deck number S (karra)
deck.description: 1 for the top deck (King eq. 4.38: D = 1.1 - 0.1 S).

wetScreening.title: Wet screening (karra)
wetScreening.description: yes applies King's factor E (p. 89); no gives E = 1.

openArea.title: Open area fraction (karra, optional)
openArea.description: Scales the basic capacity by 100 oa/OA, OA = 21.5 log10(h) + 37 (King eqs. 4.34-4.35). Absent: standard light-medium mesh.

partition.title: Partition curve (corrected)
partition.description: The corrected classification function c(d): the fraction of a size class that reports to the coarse product, before the bypass. whiten: c = 1 - (e^a - 1)/(e^(a d/d50c) + e^a - 2) (Nageswararao et al. 2004 eq. 21). rosinRammler: c = 1 - exp(-0.693 (d/d50)^m) (King 2001 eq. 4.41). tabulated: c_k declared class by class on the case's own grid, pan first.

d50.title: Cut size (rosinRammler)
d50.description: c(d50) = 0.49997 (King's constant 0.693 is kept as printed).

m.title: Sharpness m (rosinRammler)
m.description: King uses 5.9 for a vibrating screen.

corrected.title: Class values (tabulated)
corrected.description: Exactly one value per class of the case's size grid, the pan first, each in [0, 1].

bypass.title: Bypass R (declared)
bypass.description: declared only: the fraction of every class misplaced to the oversize.

fluidToOversize.title: Fluid to the oversize
fluidToOversize.description: Only when the feed carries a fluid: the fraction of it leaving with the oversize (neither model predicts it).
